notes.title: Workshop has now been added!
notes.notes: Hello everyone, I added the Steam Workshop feature to the game. At present, I have added a "Magic Book" Mod. I will continue to add some Mod, I hope you like this new feature.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.notes:
1. The game time has been changed to 10 minutes each time.

2. Add normal mode.

3. Add two new clothes colors.

4. Big optimization.

Early access is about to end and the price of the game will increase slightly.
